# Environment variables

Every environment variable harbor reads: its kind, default, meaning and owner, from `contracts/env.tsv`. The files that read a name are
found in the tree when this page is generated, never typed. A kill-switch names the controls it switches. A root variable (a path under
the repos or the box tier) is in `contracts/roots.tsv`, listed after the table.

| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_LOCK_GRACE` | tuning | `10` | Seconds an obligation lock with an unreadable owner is treated as live before it is considered stale (default 10) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_LOCK_MAX` | tuning | `900` | age in seconds past which an obligations lock is taken over regardless of its pid (default 900) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_NOW` | test-only | `computed` | Pins the UTC timestamp status-obligations treats as now, default the current time | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_ON_OVERDUE` | switch | `on` | Set to off so a fold-only obligations run does not reconcile real state when a row goes overdue (default on) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_QUIET` | tuning | `86400` | Seconds a dead owner may stay silent before its outliving obligation row lapses; default 86400 | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_READ_TIMEOUT` | tuning | `10` | Seconds one obligation source read may take before it is abandoned (default 10) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_RETAIN` | tuning | `1296000` | Seconds a closed obligation row and its transition keys are kept (default 1296000, 15 days) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_SESSIONS` | test-only | none | path of the sessions command status-obligations runs with --json; suites point it at a fixture | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_OBLIGATION_TRANSCRIPTS` | path | `$CFG/projects` | Directory of session transcripts status-obligations reads to see when a dead session last wrote, default projects under the config dir | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_PLAN_OUT` | path | `$ROOT/docs/generated/plan.md` | File the generated plan document is written to (default docs/generated/plan.md in the checkout) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_PLAN_SRC` | path | `$ROOT/docs/reports/platform-build-tickets.md` | Source markdown that status-plan-generate.sh reads; defaults to docs/reports/platform-build-tickets.md in the repo | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_SUBAGENT_GLYPH_DUMP` | path | none | When set, the subagent glyph script appends each raw payload it receives to this file; off when unset | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_SUITE_COUNTS` | value | none | Suite counts a real run already printed, such as floor-test=1095, so status-generate --check does not re-run the suites | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_WINDOW` | tuning | `3000000` | number of trailing bytes of the transcript the session-state hook scans for recent events (default 3000000) | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_STATUS_WORKFLOW` | path | `$ROOT/.github/workflows/governance.yml` | Workflow file status-generate reads for shard information, default .github/workflows/governance.yml | status |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_CHANGED` | value | none | Newline-separated list of changed file paths that test-suite-select uses instead of the git diff; pre-push sets it | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_CPU_MAX` | path | `/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max` | Path of the cgroup cpu.max file test-suite-run reads to size its job pool (default /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_CURL` | test-only | `curl` | curl command used in place of curl by ci-verified and access-browser-hosts-add; tests swap in a fake (default curl) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_GH` | test-only | `gh` | gh binary the CI scripts call, default gh; tests swap in a fake | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_IN_SUITE` | handoff | none | Set to 1 by status-generate.sh for the suite it runs so a nested status run skips re-running suites (harbor#288) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_NOW` | test-only | `computed` | Fixed epoch seconds used instead of the real clock so time-dependent CI and admission scripts are deterministic in tests | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_REQUIRE_BUN` | test-only | none | Set to 1 in the Linux governance job so a suite that needs bun fails instead of skipping when it is missing | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_REQUIRE_NODE` | test-only | none | Set to 1 in the Linux runner image so the browser test fails instead of skipping when node is missing | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_REQUIRE_VALE` | test-only | none | Set to 1 in the Linux governance job so the Vale suites fail instead of skipping when Vale is missing | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SANDBOX_DIR` | path | `$HOME/.claude-sandbox` | Sandbox config directory lint-conventions checks for the guards and floor files (default ~/.claude-sandbox) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_CACHE` | switch | none | set to 1 so a queued suite whose inputs already passed is reported as a cached row instead of being run | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_CACHE_DAYS` | tuning | `30` | Days a test-suite cache entry may go unused before it is pruned, default 30 | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_CACHE_DIR` | path | `${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache` | Directory of the suite result cache store (default ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/harbor/suite-cache) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_CACHE_SALT` | value | none | Arbitrary text hashed into every test-suite cache key; changing it forces a cold cache | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_HARD_TIMEOUT` | tuning | `computed` | Total seconds a test suite may run however much it prints (default 4 x the idle timeout; 0 means no limit) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_JOBS` | tuning | none | Number of suites test-suite-run runs at once; unset means 3 per CPU, 3 on macOS | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_SHARDS` | value | none | Repo variable holding a JSON list of shard numbers the CI suite matrix runs; unset means [1,2,3] | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_TAIL` | tuning | `40` | number of log lines shown from the end of each failed suite's log (default 40) | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_SUITE_TIMEOUT` | tuning | `900` | Seconds a suite may print nothing before test-suite-run cuts it off, default 900, 0 means no limit | test |  | tests only |
| `HARBOR_TEST_Z` | test-only | none | Throwaway variable name written into a canary fixture to prove the comment lexer reads suites correctly | test |  | tests only |

## Root variables

Held in `contracts/roots.tsv`, which `scope.root-defaults` reads; a name is registered in one of the two registers, never both.

| variable | base | path | breaks when wrong |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_REPO` | REPOS | `harbor` | the renewal check reads a missing repo and reports nothing to renew |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_FLEET_CONTROLLER` | REPOS | `projects-orchestrator` | the marker fixtures SKIP the descriptor role and the suite still exits 0 |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_FLEET_FILE` | REPOS | `projects-orchestrator/fleet.yaml` | fleet discovery finds zero projects and raises no error |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_SCAFFOLDER` | REPOS | `project-init` | the marker fixtures SKIP the allowlist role and the suite still exits 0 |
| `PROJECT_INIT_SRC` | REPOS | `project-init` | prod-guard-install ships nothing and lint drift.prod-policy-copy (was X5) compares against a missing source |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_LOCAL_BIN` | BOX | `.local/bin` | deploy writes the operator's shims somewhere nothing is on PATH |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_FLEET_CONTROLLER_BIN` | BOX | `.local/bin/projects-orchestrator` | the fleet CLI is not found: the fleet snapshot, the ship report and the runner table read fleet as absent |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_SCAFFOLDER_BIN` | BOX | `.local/bin/project-init` | the scaffolder's CLI is not found: harbor repo new and harbor yard <verb> have nothing to run |
| `HARBOR_SCOPE_SCAFFOLDER_CLONE` | BOX | `.local/share/project-init` | deploy --prune never sees yard's own bootstrap clone (yard's install.sh INSTALL_DIR), so a stale copy stays |
| `HARBOR_EVAL_REDTEAM_DIR` | REPOS | `vendor-src` | redteam-corpus finds no corpus, skips every one and stays red with nothing scored |
